text:
sarah: Heads-up: proposing onboarding raven-13b-int8 for convo-quality evals + a phased deployment plan. Need runway for quant experiments and a canary/fallback strategy. Thoughts?

mike: Agree. We should set perf/latency targets and an acceptable cost delta vs current 7B baseline. Also decide deployment mode — hosted canary first?

jess: Hosted canary first makes sense, promote to dedicated if stable. Suggest start at 3% traffic with fallback to r7b-stable. Key evals: helpfulness, safety/toxicity, hallucination rate, instruction-following.

sam: I'll run a quant grid (int8, int4 mix) this week. Can we assemble a representative promptset from prod traces + edge cases for eval harness?

sarah: Promptset: https://internal/redwood/datasets/raven-onboard-2025 (internal). Quick checklist:

```
Pre-onboard:
- perf profile: p95 latency target <= 350ms for 512 tokens
- cost target: <= 1.3x current 7B unit
- eval sets: convo-core, instruction-safety, math, long-context

Quant experiments:
- run PTQ (GPTQ) + eval int8 vs int4 mixed
- measure single-token latency, KV cache footprint, end-to-end throughput
- compute quality deltas (BLEU/EM/Instr-follow) and regression summary

Deployment & rollout:
- hosted canary: 3% traffic for 24h -> 20% for 48h -> full promote
- fallback: immediate routing to r7b-stable on errors or p99 > 2s
- rollout hooks: auto-fail if eval regression > 2% on core set or error_rate > 1%
- observability: trace IDs, sampling for contexts > 1k tokens, cost labels
```

jess: :thumbsup: Add trace sampling & cost tags. Also log model quant profile and artifact checksum with each request for audit.

mike: Infra notes: need to test on both A100-80GB and L4 to confirm kernel perf. Autoscale: cap concurrent requests per GPU to avoid OOM. Will try on g5/rtx6000 flavor too.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for raven-13b-int8 -> hosted-canary-03 at 2025-11-07T14:14:00Z

sam: Initial quant results: int8 (GPTQ) shows 0.9% RMSE vs fp16 on a holdout, latency +1.2x, mem down ~45%. I'll publish full metrics and failure cases by EOD.

sarah: Please also lock monitoring dashboard: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, and a quality regression alert comparing the canary to baseline model on the eval harness.

jess: Also flag for private deployments: does quantization change leakage or fingerprinting properties? cc elaine-security

elaine-security: Elaine: quick security note — ensure model artifacts are encrypted with customer KMS in private, and that hosted audit logs include model_version + quant_profile. I'll review the artifact pipeline.

mike: Draft rollout config (infra example):

```
{
  "model": "raven-13b-int8-v1",
  "canary": {"traffic_pct": 3, "duration": "24h"},
  "fallback": {"on_error": "route:r7b-stable-v3", "on_latency_threshold_ms": 2000},
  "metrics": ["p99_latency", "error_rate", "eval_regression_core"]
}
```

sarah: Action items: sam run full quant grid by Fri; mike provision test nodes + autoscale caps; jess set up eval harness + dashboards; elaine verify encryption/audit. Reconvene Mon for go/no-go. Thanks all!
